integrity: All theorem statements and qualifications are supported by the complete proof and the included separately implemented finite Apéry computations. Claims of absolute bibliographic novelty or independent mathematical certification are not made.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotic minimal Frobenius number and genus only for complete-intersection semigroups of embedding dimension three. The exact finite-multiplicity minimum, optimal lower-order term and minimizer classification remain unresolved. Existence uses classical gluing. Finite checks are not proof of an infinite statement.
title: Sharp square-root Frobenius growth for three-generated complete-intersection numerical semigroups
